name: block-test-skips
description: Blocks newly added test skips, focus markers and runner options that hide tests: pytest/unittest skips, non-strict xfail, importorskip; JS skip/only/todo/fixme, x/f prefixes; JUnit Disabled/Assume; Go Skip, Short(); Rust ignore; RSpec, PHPUnit, C#, Swift skips; --deselect/-k not, collect_ignore, jest testPathIgnorePatterns. Runs: commit, agent write, turn's end; only additions judged. Friction: computed names evade it. Waiver: 'chock: allow test-skip' same line; agent: only if in HEAD. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
